description: Zero-dependency contracts and primitives for the ShreePdf ecosystem: IPdfDocumentGenerator, IPdfTextExtractor, PdfGenerationRequest, PdfExtractedDocument, PdfEmbeddedAttachment, and theme/geometry descriptors for .NET Standard 2.0, .NET 8.0, and .NET 10.0.
Tagged PDF (Section 508 & ISO 14289-1), alt-text annotations, and ISO 14289-1 PDF/UA & Section 508 accessibility compliance helpers for ShreePdf.
Interactive AcroForm field descriptors, form filling, and static vector form flattening add-on for ShreePdf. Supports textboxes, checkboxes, dropdowns, and signature widgets.

Convenience meta-package that references the entire ShreePdf family: core vector engine, Markdown & HTML ingestion, vector charts/barcodes/QR, interactive AcroForms, AES-256 security/PKCS#12/PDF-A/ZUGFeRD, ISO 32000-1 PDF Portfolios, Tagged PDF/UA accessibility, DI integration, Microsoft.Extensions…
Vector data visualization descriptors and builders for ShreePdf: Bar, Line, Area, Pie, and Donut charts, KPI stat cards, sparklines, progress bars, Code128/EAN-13 barcodes, and ISO 18004 QR codes.

Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection integration for ShreePdf. Call services.AddShreePdf(...) to register IPdfDocumentGenerator, IPdfDocumentExtractor, and default PdfGenerationRequest options with ILogger diagnostic bridging.
Microsoft.Extensions.AI integration for ShreePdf. Convert ChatResponse and ChatMessage Markdown outputs directly into themed, auto-fitted vector PDFs with embedded RAG structured metadata.
Semantic Kernel integration for ShreePdf. Render Kernel prompt results directly to vector PDFs and extract lossless RAG structured metadata for vector database indexing.

Lightweight HTML and Razor view-to-PDF conversion extensions for ShreePdf. Renders HTML headings, paragraphs, inline CSS, lists, tables, and images directly to high-speed vector PDFs with zero Chromium overhead.

Markdown and LLM response to vector PDF conversion extensions for ShreePdf. Renders headings, tables, inline images, links, callouts, and {{token}} mail-merge templates directly into themed PDFs without headless browsers.
ISO 32000-1 PDF Portfolios (multi-file document packages), embedded attachment extraction, and compressed multi-document envelope builders for ShreePdf.

Enterprise security, ISO 32000-1 AES-256 encryption, PKCS#12 digital signatures, RFC 3161 TSA timestamping, permanent PII redaction, PDF/A-1b/2b/3b archival, and ZUGFeRD / Factur-X XML e-invoicing extensions for ShreePdf.

A dotnet global/local CLI tool that runs ShreePdf from any terminal or CI/CD runner: `shreepdf md2pdf`, `shreepdf html2pdf`, `shreepdf extract`, and `shreepdf merge`. Fully offline with zero headless browser dependencies.

Reads and writes the stream-json protocol of claude -p (Claude Code): typed events, commands, a session and swappable transports. Community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

PostgreSQL provider for cl2j.Database, on Npgsql, with binary COPY for bulk inserts. Requires PostgreSQL 13 or later.
